periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, diverging superiorly.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovals, with height significantly exceeding width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the inferior terminus displaced medially toward the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness at lateral flanks, appearing to cover approximately one-third of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation approximately equal to the transverse width of the upper cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness, exhibiting a regular semicircular convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Small vertical dark fur marking located on the nasal bridge, medially situated between the two periocular patches.
